messages:
Tanya: Quick sync: we need a short migration playbook that covers v1->v2 API, model swap guidance, and a tiny CLI migration helper. Goal: land PRs this week and publish a short 'breaking changes' note.
Omar: I can draft the CLI helper (node + python wrappers) that normalizes old `invoke` calls to `responses.create`. Keeps examples simple.
Ben: I'll take the playbook text and a 'how to rollback' subsection for model rollouts. Include a sample canary config.
Tanya: Good. Also we should avoid changing public slugs; prefer redirects for removed pages. Add a redirect for any page we rename.
Claire: I'll check the blog post that references the old curl examples and update those too. Found 4 blog references.
Omar: CLI helper pseudo: `ri-migrate --file example.js --replace-invoke` which swaps patterns like `client.invoke(...)` to `await client.responses.create({model: X, input: Y})`. Will add tests.
Tanya: Nice. Make sure it warns on custom parsing logic and opens a linting PR for SDKs to flag `.text` access.
Ben: Playbook structure:
- quick summary of breaking changes
- sample code diffs (TS, Py, curl)
- how to extract plain text from structured responses
- model swap checklist (smoke latency, outputs, embeddings)
- rollback example (alias fallback)

Omar: Curl example replacement I'll add to helper README:
OLD: `curl -X POST /v1/invoke -d '{"model":"r-classic","prompt":"Hi"}'`
NEW: `curl -X POST /v2/responses -d '{"model":"r-classic-2024-02","input":"Hi"}'`

Claire: I opened a PR for the blog fixes and added `docs/deprecation-migrate` label. docs-bot: PR #8932 created.
docs-bot: New issue to track CLI helper tests: #455.
SRE: Small ops note: if customers hit increased latency on new model variants, we recommend routing to `model_fallback` for 10% of traffic for 24h, monitor token costs. Add that under runbook.
Tanya: Add a short section on telemetry metrics to watch: p50/p95 latency, token-per-request, error-rate, model-quality regressions via eval sets.
Ben: I'll draft the rollback snippet using aliasing config example (YAML): `rollout:
  model: r-classic-2024-02
  canary: 0.1
  fallback: r-classic-2023-11`
Omar: I'll add a unit test for the CLI that ensures the transformed snippet uses `responses.create` and handles `output[0].content` extraction helper.
Claire: QA notes: we should run smoke across the public examples page and the blog posts after changes. I'll coordinate with QA to run `npm run smoke:examples`.
Tanya: Final: pile up small PRs, tag `bounty-eligible` for quick fixes, and I'll publish the deprecation notice draft to /docs/news once merges are in. If anyone finds stray `invoke` occurrences, paste them here.
SRE: Lodged a post-deploy check: monitor 5 customer routes for 72h.
Tanya: Thanks all. Closing after merges and smoke green.
